```sql
    SELECT geometry
    FROM read_parquet('divisions_area')
    WHERE id = 'cbd40d09-c3f1-4d5f-8167-2843b0b7b8cc'
)

-- Find all states (regions) that touch Baleshwar
SELECT
    d.id,
    d.names."primary" AS name,
    ST_AsGeoJSON(d.geometry) AS geometry
FROM read_parquet('divisions_area') AS d
JOIN baleshwar AS b
  ON ST_Touches(d.geometry, b.geometry)   -- states that share a border
WHERE d.subtype = 'region';
```

```sql
-- Find all counties that lie within 25 km of Khordha (id = '02e869b1-62aa-4b00-816c-691837f4b347')
WITH nearby AS (
    SELECT d2.id,
           d2.names."primary" AS name,
           d2.subtype,
           d2.region,
           ST_AsGeoJSON(d2.geometry) AS geometry
    FROM read_parquet('divisions_area') d1
    JOIN read_parquet('divisions_area') d2
      ON ST_DWithin(d1.geometry, d2.geometry, 25000)   -- 25 km
    WHERE d1.id = '02e869b1-62aa-4b00-816c-691837f4b347'
      AND d2.id <> d1.id
)
-- Return the distinct states/union territories that contain those counties
SELECT DISTINCT
       id,
       name,
       geometry
FROM nearby
WHERE subtype = 'county'
ORDER BY name;
```
